article.headline: Dominic Calvert-Lewin denies Man United a first Premier League win since Aug. 30
article.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin's second-half equaliser extended Manchester United's winless Premier League run to five matches as they were held 1-1 by rivals Leeds.
